The ''''The Brave Little Sapling'''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall.  It can be won in the [[Movie Theater#Crane Game|Crane Game]] inside the [[Movie Theater]], during {{season|spring}}, when the movie "The Brave Little Sapling" is playing in the Movie Theater.

This poster is displayed outside the [[Movie Theater]] while the movie is playing, and the season before it's featured.
